title: Oh, What a Tangled Web We Weave…
summary: I have been spending a good portion of yesterday afternoon and this morning fielding questions about the effect that CoreWeave (CRWV) and its bonds are having on broader markets. In more normal times, credit concerns at a single corporate borrower should not resonate dramatically throughout global equity and fixed income markets, but these are not normal times. The artificial intelligence buildout has become such a key factor not only in markets, but in the global economy writ large, that tremors in a relatively marginal player can resonate wildly.
